name: ai-plugins
description: Personal plugin marketplace for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot.

plugins.name: harness-kit
plugins.description: Tools that measure and check the Claude Code harness: profile-session profiles finished work sessions (model calls, weighted cost, estimated cost in USD, context growth, cache behaviour and the share of the plan limit used).

plugins.name: issue-kit
plugins.description: GitHub issue workflow for Claude Code: take an issue or a batch of issues from plan to pull request with planner, developer, build and ship agents, commit and pull-request conventions, a commit message check and per-repository configuration.

plugins.name: jobsearch-kit
plugins.description: Job search workflow: vacancy analysis, CVs tailored from one master file, cover letters, application records and call transcripts, built as Word and PDF documents.
